Purpose
-------
This document contains safe, repeatable commands to:

- create a `develop` branch based on `main` ,
- remove all git tags locally and remotely,
- delete remote branches except `main` and `develop`,
- optionally close open PRs created by Dependabot or other automated users.

Prerequisites
-------------
- Local clone of the repository with `origin` set to the target remote.
- `git` and `gh` (GitHub CLI) installed and authenticated, if you will close PRs via CLI.
- Admin permissions on the remote repository to delete tags/branches and close PRs.

Warning
-------
These commands are destructive. Verify you are targeting the correct remote. Do not run in a production repository without approval.

Step-by-step (PowerShell-friendly)
---------------------------------

# 1) Fetch and ensure `main` is up to date
git fetch --prune origin

# Replace `main` with alternate primary if needed
git checkout main
git pull origin main

# 2) Create and push `develop` from `main`
# If your primary branch has a different name, replace `main` with that branch.
git checkout -b develop origin/main
git push -u origin develop

# 3) Delete all local tags
git tag -l | ForEach-Object { git tag -d $_ }

# 4) Delete all remote tags
# This collects remote tag names and deletes them on `origin`.
git ls-remote --tags origin | ForEach-Object { $_ -split "\t" } | ForEach-Object { $_[-1] } | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace "refs/tags/", "" } | ForEach-Object { git push --delete origin $_ }

# 5) Delete remote branches except `main` and `develop`
# List remote heads, filter, and delete. Review the list before deletion.
$exempt = @('refs/heads/main','refs/heads/develop')
$branches = git ls-remote --heads origin | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split "\t")[-1] }
$toDelete = $branches | Where-Object { $exempt -notcontains $_ }
if ($toDelete) {
  Write-Host "Remote branches to delete:"; $toDelete
  foreach ($b in $toDelete) {
    $name = $b -replace 'refs/heads/', ''
    git push origin --delete $name
  }
} else { Write-Host "No remote branches to delete." }

# 6) (Optional) Close open Dependabot PRs
# List open PRs by Dependabot and close them.
if (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
  $prNumbers = gh pr list --state open --author dependabot[bot] --json number --jq '.[].number'
  if ($prNumbers) {
    foreach ($n in $prNumbers) { gh pr close $n --comment "Closed by init-git-branches skill" }
  } else { Write-Host "No open Dependabot PRs found." }
} else { Write-Host "gh CLI not installed or available; skipping PR close step." }

Notes
-----
- Default primary branch in these instructions is `main`. No other name (like master) is allowed.
- If branch protection prevents deletion, you'll need to temporarily disable protections or delete branches via the web UI with the correct permissions.
- Review the list of branches to delete before confirming.
